texts.label: text
texts.orig: Lupolen 3621 M RM is a new generation hexene linear low density polyethylene for rotational molding.  Typical customer applications include agricultural and chemical storage containers and technical parts. This product exhibits excellent ESCR and high impact strength at low temperatures . Lupolen 3621 M RM is a UV-stabilized and pelletized polymer: Tests have shown that this material is resisting against the harmful effect of biodiesel It is not intended for use in medical and pharmaceutical applications.
